_comment: Porter MCP server for Claude Code. HOW TO APPLY: merge the mcpServers.porter block into your project .mcp.json (project scope) or ~/.claude.json (user scope) — do NOT replace the whole file. Replace {{PORTER_TOKEN}} with a real Porter access token (mint via the OAuth flow; needs memory.read + memory.write, prefer memory.read.<tag> for least privilege). REMOTE ALTERNATIVE: instead of stdio you can point Claude Code at Porter's Streamable HTTP endpoint (POST http://localhost:8000/mcp) with an Authorization: Bearer header — see DEPLOY.md. No secrets are stored in this file.
